---
title: "Pamflow Soundscape Analysis Report"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
params:
  run_id: ""
  hourly_plots: NULL
  diel_plots: NULL
  cov_dt: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Overview

This report summarizes ecoacoustic soundscape indices generated by **pamflow** for Run ID: **`r params$run_id`**.

Indices follow Bradfer-Lawrence et al. (2019) guidelines. Day phase is 06:00–17:59; Night phase is 18:00–05:59.

## Site Covariates Summary

Mean and Standard Deviation (SD) of acoustic indices split by Day and Night.

```{r cov-table}
if (!is.null(params$cov_dt) && nrow(params$cov_dt) > 0) {
  knitr::kable(params$cov_dt, digits = 2, caption = "Site-level soundscape covariates")
} else {
  cat("No site covariate table available.")
}
```

## 24-Hour Diel Profiles

Hourly mean index values by grid (local time).

```{r hourly-plots, results='asis', fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
if (!is.null(params$hourly_plots) && length(params$hourly_plots) > 0) {
  for (idx in names(params$hourly_plots)) {
    cat("### ", toupper(idx), "\n\n")
    print(params$hourly_plots[[idx]])
    cat("\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No hourly diel plots available.")
}
```

## Day vs. Night Comparisons

Mean index values by diel phase and grid.

```{r diel-plots, results='asis', fig.width=7, fig.height=4.5}
if (!is.null(params$diel_plots) && length(params$diel_plots) > 0) {
  for (idx in names(params$diel_plots)) {
    cat("### ", toupper(idx), "\n\n")
    print(params$diel_plots[[idx]])
    cat("\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No day/night phase plots available.")
}
```
